horoscope: This is a good day for entertainment, play, and big feelings, dear Aries, but as the day advances, it's strong for work or productivity. A New Moon will occur tomorrow, and interests or direction can change. It's bound to help you define new goals. Today, you need games, fun, and creative expression. Your romantic inclinations are stronger than usual, as well. Energies are good for building your faith and confidence, as well as for making or boosting connections. It can be a prosperous time for love and friendship, as you're cooperating with others, and they're returning the favor. You seem to more easily attract people who are supportive or who encourage your happiness goals into your life. You fare particularly well in one-to-one situations, with a partner, counselor, or the like. Issues of equality in relationships can be in focus today, and your powers of negotiation are better than usual.

There is a homebody attitude today that is distinctive, dear Taurus, and your tendency to stick with familiar people, situations, and things, in fact, fills a current need. You're checking in with your innermost needs and seeking more security and comfort. This can prepare you well for a more outgoing period to come. Tomorrow, a New Moon will occur in your creative and romantic sector, and the Moon moves into this area of your solar chart later today. Today, you'd be wise to get in touch with what's in your heart. Today is also a strong time to make practical connections, particularly with people or information related to career, work, health, and business goals. You enjoy helping others, and others tend to offer encouragement or insight that benefits you in turn. There is a distinctly cooperative feel to the day that lifts your spirits.

There is an increasing focus on home and personal life, dear Gemini, as well as the need for more downtime. However, you begin today craving some excitement or, at the very least, a busy pace. You are curious and connected. Temporarily, you may not be especially in touch with your deeper emotions. However, it's a good time for making connections related to romance, creativity, publishing, writing, legal affairs, entertainment, and education. You might connect with someone who encourages your spirit and vision. The desire to grow, improve, and move ahead is prominent.

You're inclined to want to settle in today, dear Cancer, although as the day advances, your curiosity grows. You're in a positive frame of mind and don't like to linger on problem areas unless you have the tools to make changes. You are seeking emotional security today, and earthy, grounding activities can benefit you greatly. With a New Moon occurring tomorrow, it's a better time for reflection than new initiatives. Right now, there is a strong focus on your inner world, intimate relationships, and connections with family. People closest to you seem to be your biggest supporters right now, or you might make helpful connections with others related to finances, real estate, home initiatives, family, and intimacy. Emotional bonds can strengthen, and people seem more cooperative.

It's not easy to hide what you're feeling today, dear Leo. Even if you're not verbally expressing your emotions, they are written on your face! You're in an excellent position to discover feelings you may have buried or brushed aside, but keep in mind that they may be larger than life right now. Today is better for reflecting and observing rather than starting brand-new projects due to tomorrow's New Moon, which tends to redirect you. It's also a fine time for cooperating, as you can feel especially supported regarding your ideas and interests. There can be a sense of mutual harmony and a general boost in peaceful feelings with and through others. You might make helpful connections related to education, personal interests, communications, and transportation. Cooperation brings rewards and possibly some meaningful feedback.

You can be more sensitive to the emotional atmosphere around you than usual today, dear Virgo, but you're getting in better touch with your intuition. A New Moon will occur in your sign tomorrow, and you can start fresh. For now, think about tying up loose ends. You need more moments of quiet and solitude to regroup. You may want to stay in the background or avoid the spotlight for now, which gives you the chance to center yourself. Today's energies are strong for cooperation, and people seem supportive of your goals. This is a generally good time for making connections with people related to finances, work, or health, such as co-workers, employers, bankers, and health care. It's a good day for an easy, comfortable pace. With less pressure or stress today, you feel all the more productive.

You're most at home in the world of your social life or networking today, dear Libra, although as the day advances, you can be a little more insular. Until then, you may be looking to friends for nurturance or to cherished dreams and goals for inspiration. It's a better day for cooperative or solo activities than competitive ones. It's not the best time for chores or responsibilities, which may weigh on your conscience to some degree, but you're not interested in going that route right now. Your desire to connect or express yourself gets a boost, and your popularity can bump up a notch, as well. You get a strong sense that you can move beyond blockages.

Your ambitions are stirring today, dear Scorpio, but brand new beginnings should wait until after the New Moon tomorrow. Today is better for winding down, and quiet time, relaxation, and familiar settings are a strong draw. Thoughtful consideration of what you may want to improve is highly favored, particularly on a social level. Right now, you get a boost from activities that connect you with your feelings and those you care about, and there can be rewards in your interactions related to family, health, or counsel. Venus harmonizing with the North Node tends to promote cooperation. You're exceptionally comfortable and at ease with others. Others' talents or resources can benefit you now.

You may be longing for some fresh energy, more freedom, or open spaces today, dear Sagittarius. It's not the time for dull routines, and if you're stuck in them, take extra breaks or find creative ways to enliven your day. You're taking a special interest in sharing ideas and knowledge. Today is better for freestyling than for substantial new beginnings, as it's a day before a New Moon. Still, you're in great shape for connecting with people who are supportive and helpful, and you'll find that diplomacy takes you far. Mutually beneficial relationships are in focus. Friend or group connections and networking can be empowering now. A friend can provide a sounding board or simple feedback that helps you reach important conclusions.

There is an increasing focus on connecting and sharing in your life these days, dear Capricorn, and this theme will be with you for some time longer. However, you're in an observant, introspective frame of mind much of today, on this day before a New Moon. You're drawn to mysteries and puzzles, as well as the deeper layers of people and life in general. You might relish a little time to yourself, hidden away. Your intuitive faculties are in great form now, so take advantage and learn more about what you need and want. This way, after the New Moon, you'll be in a better position to dream up plans that truly inspire you. Still, you might bond with someone over shared basic values or business ideas.

You're inclined to seek out company, collaboration, and input or feedback right now, dear Aquarius, and there can be stronger emotions surrounding relationships today. Interaction is vital to emotional satisfaction right now, and it can be revealing as you discover more about yourself through your dealings with others. You are likely to feel a stronger desire for harmony, peace, and balance than usual. It's a generally strong time for pursuing goals that contribute to a sense of growth and feelings of productivity. Happy connections with others can figure strongly. Someone may encourage your independence and self-confidence, or you may help guide someone, and it's rewarding. Still, on this day before a New Moon, it's a good idea to reflect and wind down.

This is a potentially good time to connect with others, particularly related to emotional health, finances, or intimacy, dear Pisces. You can experience a powerful draw to someone on an intimate level now. Good energy is with you to see both the details and the bigger picture, and you may feel that you can combine detailed work with more adventurous or bold activities quite successfully, without either truly suffering. Disorganization and imbalance are disruptive to your mood right now, and the best way to take care of this is to focus on putting things in order one step at a time.
